Investigator runs its search plan (read tools)
mail.search · chat.search · contracts.find_clause
crm.notes · policy_memo.lookup · workbook.lookup
memory.facts · memory.policies · similar_decisions

span.p:
Explaining evidence found?
quote is a substring of its trace (kernel E)
party, amount and date tie

span.p:
Not blocked → propose_entry + workpaper
and record_fact_candidate from the evidence
no human is asked

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXAMPLE A · Initech pays $10,800 on $12,000
CEO email of 28 Jun found: 10% off through renewal
→ fact (stated_by CEO) WITHOUT asking anyone

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pre 1 · search plan exhausted
every planned source queried, zero explaining hits
sources + hit counts saved on the decision trace

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pre 2 · no active fact or policy covers it
memory.facts(party_id, predicate, date) empty
memory.policies(function, kind) no condition match

span.p:
handoff over the event bus, e.g. AR asks revenue
no human involved, intent stays with agents

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

dedupe key: party_id + predicate + decision kind
looked up in the escalation table

span.p:
Already asked → reuse answer_json, or attach this
intent to the open escalation (no second message)
repeat-question counter must stay 0

span.p: ESCALATE

span.p:
Who 1 · crm.owner(party_id)
account owner (HubSpot deal owner)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Who 2 · approval matrix (policy_memo.lookup)
does the owner have authority for this amount?
if not, ask the role that does

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Who 3 · fallback: function owner (intent.owner)
then the controller

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
asked_user resolved to a Slack user id
(account owners are seeded as Slack users)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payload 1 · what happened, with amounts
integer cents computed by code, never by the model
invoice id, expected, received, shortfall

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payload 2 · what was checked
each source searched, query, hit count
so the human does not repeat the search

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payload 3 · what is unknown
one sentence naming the missing context

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payload 4 · 2 to 4 proposed treatments
credit_memo · dispute_hold · write_off · chase
each with an entry preview (dr/cr, kernel F dry run)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payload 5 · default if no answer by the deadline
dispute_hold: balance stays open, never write off
re-ping, then ask the fallback user

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payload 6 · deadline
tied to the blocked checklist_item in the close
(AR concessions reviewed, July close)

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Wording drafted by claude-haiku-4-5
numbers and entry previews injected by code
validated with a zod schema → question_json

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
escalation
id, decision_id, asked_user, question_json,
answer_json, asked_at, answered_at, slack_ts

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
intent.status = waiting_on_human
event topic: human.escalation.opened

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
close.mark(item, blocked, reason)
checklist_item.status = blocked
blocked_reason = escalation id + who was asked

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Public request URL available?
(cloudflared or ngrok tunnel)

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Path A · Slack message with buttons
one button per treatment + Other (free text)
interaction payload POSTed to the request URL

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Path B (fallback) · threaded message
bot polls replies on slack_ts, or Socket Mode
no public URL needed

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human in Slack
account owner / CEO / controller
(demo: the phone of a judge)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Signature verification (Path A)
HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + body, signing secret
reject if timestamp older than 5 min

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Identity check
answerer Slack id equals asked_user
OR answerer has authority in the approval matrix

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Not authorised → answer ignored
bot replies in thread, escalation stays open
attempt stored as a trace
